item.title: commandline: Cheap code, precious trust: Code modernization at scale
item.description:
The article discusses the promise and challenges of agentic software engineering for large-scale code migration and language modernization. It frames modernization at scale as a trust and execution problem, not just a tooling problem.

  • Source: Microsoft Command Line Blog
